title: Delegate literature retrieval policy to skill
description: Removes concrete literature retrieval tool order from AGENTS.md so paper lookup and topic search policy are owned by the literature-search skill and tool schema versions.
changes: Remove specific paper lookup tool order from AGENTS.md.
Remove topic-search tool invocation details from AGENTS.md, including truthfulness checklist references.
Keep only high-level task boundaries: real sources, no fabricated papers, no automatic upgrade from single-paper lookup to topic survey.
Delegate retrieval strategy, query variants, fallback policy, and candidate verification to the literature-search skill.

rollback.notes: Restore the previous AGENTS snapshot if delegating too much to the skill reduces routing reliability.
